label: Link
depicts: Two chain loops joined diagonally with open curved ends facing inward
use_when: Use when the interface wants a linked chain shown on a diagonal without extra breaks or sparks.
avoid_when: Do not use for the parallel or looped links when the diagonal join is the key cue.

label: Link
depicts: Two chain loops joined on a diagonal with straighter inner connector bars
use_when: Use when the interface wants the diagonal chain link variant with straighter inner bar segments.
avoid_when: Do not use for the more curved diagonal chain when the inner straight bars matter.

label: Link
depicts: Two rounded chain loops interlocked horizontally with a centered join
use_when: Use when the interface wants a horizontal interlocked chain rather than a diagonal one.
avoid_when: Do not use for the diagonal link variants when the loops should sit side by side.

label: Unlink
depicts: Broken diagonal chain loops with four short spark marks around the split
use_when: Use when the interface wants a broken chain icon with spark marks around the separation.
avoid_when: Do not use for intact links when the break and surrounding spark marks matter.

label: Unlink
depicts: Broken diagonal chain loops with separated halves and spark marks above and below
use_when: Use when the interface wants the broken chain variant whose two halves pull farther apart.
avoid_when: Do not use for the tighter broken link when the wider split between halves should remain visible.
